construction.electric_fibre_basis: Select an integral tree solution k_rho of DI k_rho=rhoI with chord coordinates0. rhoI is integer for every finite canonical CAR occupation state. Full electric eigen labels are E=C(m+b)+k_rho, m inZ^d and ONE b in[0,1)^d. This follows from reduced twist exp(-2pi i λ_n rho): chord longitudinal components h_rho give Qk_rho=-C h_rho. It is not E=Pi alone.
construction.native_hop_update: A charged offsite native path has signed dynamic integer flow inc (only existing dynamic scalar edges). Its Peierls multiplier shifts FULL E byinc and density byDI inc. m changes by integer cycle coordinates of k_rho+inc-k_rho_new, while b remains EXACTLY unchanged. Neutral hops, charged onsite and fullPhi/SU4 terms do not change raw electric labels; HC is the longitudinal part of the same HE64, not added again in this formula.
construction.trace_selection: Closing CAR occupations implies only DI sum_inc=0. A heat trace in the electric momentum basis additionally requires sum_inc=0 as a RAW dynamic vector. A nonzero closed integer cycle shifts m and has zero diagonal. Therefore an interior Wilson/CAR face word may return its canonical mask yet contribute0 to electric trace. Complete colour contraction, Phi coefficients, SU4 gauge projection and all64 spectator roles do not alter this necessary selection. A pinned-boundary-only loop has inc0 and can pass; its actual quantum coefficient/sign remains unpaid.
construction.single_common_character_integral: For a trace-eligible finite word, let v_j=k_rho_initial+inc_cumulative,j, t_j>=0, beta=sum t_j>0. Summing ONE initialm and integrating ONE commonb combines to x inR^d: integral dx exp[-64 sum_j t_j||Cx+v_j||^2]. Define vbar=beta^-1 sum t_j v_j. Exact completion of squares equals tE(beta) exp[-64 sum_j t_j||D^TLI^-1rho_j||^2 -64 sum_j t_j||Q(v_j-vbar)||^2], tE=(pi/(64beta))^(d/2)/sqrt(detLI). Fullrho_j=DI v_j. The FIRST exponent is shared HC history, the SECOND transverse time-variance is electric memory. Neither can be dropped.
construction.reset_b_wrongcase: Fresh independent b/m at each time slice instead factors Gaussian integrals and erases transverse memory (and generally changes tE normalizer). Even dividing by artificially adjusted free factors does not restore the missing exponential. It is NOT the canonical thermal functional. In the exact heat-kernel/Trotter representation b is fixed across the entire closed imaginary-time path and integrated once outside its conditional quantum/CAR history.
construction.normalization: This conditional electric factor is exact under any full quantum field and colour history. It is not a full native CAR/field thermal coefficient: arbitrary unbounded-Phi word sums, field/SU4 expectations, Trotter and quadrature errors are still separately owed for a numerical pressure. The native broad heat/response enclosures do not truncate these histories.
